about: The code bases agent sessions may work on, and the environments they run in (bench/agentic_data). A session's workspace holds only files of an approved code base whose licence scan verdict is ok (license_scan.py); gate.py refuses any other. Each entry pins an exact version, names the approved source in bench/staircase_drafter/sources.json it belongs to, and gives the licence (SPDX), the attribution and the change summary that the published dataset's NOTICE carries. Status 'approved' needs the owner's date; 'proposed' entries are inventoried candidates waiting for the owner.
rule: Licence allows redistribution and derivatives (MIT, BSD-2/3-Clause, Apache-2.0, PSF/Python-2.0); no copyleft, no extra usage terms; human-written code of known provenance; files with a notice of another licence, vendored folders, binaries and large data files are left out file by file.
